applicant_profile.purchaser_type: Commercial bank, savings bank, or savings association

scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm wondering if you can help me with the status of my application. I applied for a conventional loan to purchase a home, and I'm hoping to get some updates. Could you tell me if my application has been approved, denied, or is still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan was originated for $105,000 with a 30-year term.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. I'm glad to hear that my application was approved. Could you please tell me what my interest rate is and if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 10.5%. There are no high-cost or negative amortization flags on your loan.

dialogue.user: I see. I was expecting a lower interest rate given the current market conditions. Could you also tell me if my loan has been sold to another institution and what my debt-to-income ratio is?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to a commercial bank, savings bank, or savings association. The record does not include your debt-to-income ratio.

dialogue.user: I understand. Thank you for the information. Could you please confirm the type of loan product I was approved for and the total costs of this loan?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a Conventional:First Lien loan product. The record does not include the total costs of the loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information. I'm a bit surprised by the interest rate, but I understand that's what was approved. I appreciate your help. <Satisfied>
